create_policy_bot: create a PolicyBot instance that samples actions from a policy distribution for a given player
run_policy_bot_step: run the PolicyBot step method to select a stochastic action from legal actions based on policy probabilities
test_policy_bot_step_with_policy: test the PolicyBot step_with_policy method to return both action probabilities and the sampled action
review_policy_bot_player_id: review the PolicyBot player_id method that returns the integer id of the player for this bot
build_policy_bot_restart: build a PolicyBot restart_at method that resets the bot state at a given game state
